source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Your **LEAGUES OF VOTANN** units get this ability:

**Guerrilla Adepts**: after being **selected to shoot** in [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), this unit can pick an enemy unit, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit. Then:

- its models' attacks can target nothing but that enemy unit, which must be an eligible target, for the rest of the phase
- once those attacks are resolved, if any of them hit that enemy unit, it is assailed until [your next Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase); assailed is only a label, used by this ability and by some Stratagems and Enhancements
- if that enemy unit was assailed already, it is also pinned until then

A pinned unit gets -2" M and -2 to its [Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step).

trigger.after: selected to shoot in your Shooting phase

afterAttacks.expires: start of your next Shooting phase
